SYMBOLS (EXCEPT CONNECTOR AND GROUNDING)
Devices appearing in circuit diagrams are indicated by the following symbols.
WIRE COLOR CODES
Wire color are identified by the following color codes.
If a cable has two colors, the first of the two color code 
characters indicates the basic color (color of the cable coating) 
and the second indicates the marking color.
NOTE: 
*: No code indicates 0.5 mm2(0.0008 in2).Cable color code in 
parentheses indicates 0.3 mm2 (0.0005 in2).
